snippet.title: Farlight Devlog Log 01: Combat Feedback | Farlight 84
snippet.description:
Why does pulling the trigger feel amazing in some games—but fall flat in others?
In this first episode of our Farlight Devlog series, we uncover the truth behind hit feedback—the science, tech, and design that make every shot feel just right.
From visual effects to sound design, see how the Farlight 84 team creates that addictive feeling of impact.

ABOUT FARLIGHT 84

In Farlight 84, you get to play as heroes with unique skills to outsmart your enemies, unleashing special abilities to catch them off guard... AND you get to collect adorable Buddies to join you as loyal companions in battle. Buddy up, it’s time to Battle Royale!
